beforeDevCommand.script: cd ../webui && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run build:web

build.beforeBuildCommand: cd ../webui && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run build:web

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws://127.0.0.1:*

bundle.longDescription: Build, test, and ship from FluentCI Studio. Local pipelines, live logs, execution spans, and CI exports in a native desktop app.
